leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Create a CartService that holds items as a writable Signal using signal()
Derive the total item count and subtotal as computed() Signals with no manual calculation triggers
Use effect() to synchronise cart state with localStorage as a side effect, without subscribing to observables
Consume Signal values in a template without the async pipe and observe that Angular re-renders only the badge
Bridge existing RxJS streams into the signal world using toSignal() with an initialValue
Apply OnPush to the badge component and explain why Signals make OnPush less brittle than @Input-only approaches
Compare the Signals implementation with the equivalent BehaviorSubject + async pipe version and articulate the tradeoffs
